title: Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.33062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zeroth-order optimization has emerged as a resource-efficient alternative to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) when fine-tuning LLMs, thanks to the inherent low dimensionality of the loss landscape. It relies on a two-point estimate of the gradient that only accesses the function value and not the gradient, bypassing the resource-heavy backpropagation. Recently, it was accidentally discovered that per-sample clipping can improve the performance of the trained model, while running a differentially private version of zeroth-order optimization \cite{zhang2024dpzero} with a very large privacy parameter $\epsilon$ (corresponding to very little privacy). translated_title: 理解零阶优化中的裁剪机制
translated_abstract: 零阶优化已成为微调大语言模型（LLM）时替代随机梯度下降（SGD）的一种节省资源的方法，这得益于损失景观固有的低维特性。它依赖于梯度的两点估计，只需访问函数值而无需计算梯度，从而绕过了资源消耗巨大的反向传播过程。最近，人们在以非常大的隐私参数 $\epsilon$（对应于几乎没有隐私保护）运行差分隐私版本的零阶优化时，偶然发现逐样本裁剪可以提升训练后模型的性能。在本文中，我们系统地研究了这一现象，并证明：(i) 学习率 $\eta$ 的最优选择与裁剪阈值 $c$ 成反比，满足 $\eta c =$ 常数；(ii) 裁剪会使零阶优化收敛到不同的解……
tldr: 本文系统研究了逐样本裁剪为何能提升零阶优化性能这一现象，证明了最优学习率与裁剪阈值成反比（即 ηc 为常数），并且裁剪会使零阶优化收敛到不同的解。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates why per-sample clipping improves zeroth-order optimization, demonstrating that the optimal learning rate is inversely proportional to the clipping threshold (ηc = constant) and that clipping drives the optimization toward a different solution.
